items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: First he was working with Huey Masakela. He spent some time with that band.

ctx.x: Talk about how that came about.

It came about with René. He went. First he was working with Huey Masakela. He spent some time with that band. Then he was offered – he went on tour with them through South Africa. He met a lady, and they married and had a couple of babies. So that began the connection between South Africa and my family and the McLean family in South Africa. I have two granddaughters there. I guess that’s it. Then we did a State Department tour over there in 1993. We traveled to six countries in southern Africa and did…
Was Hotep in the band at that time?
